name: Hospital Horror

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

languages: understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Needles
traits.summary: Taking Piercing damage gives it Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
traits.text: If the horror takes Piercing damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.summary: Advantage on an attack roll against a target that has a non-Incapacitated ally of this creature within 5 ft.
traits.text: The horror has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of that creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

bonus_actions.name: Stim Burst
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the Dash action and can jump up to 30 ft by spending 10 ft of movement.
bonus_actions.text: The horror takes the Dash action and can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

summary: A patient mutilated into a raging, many-bladed thing that swarms with others and leaps on prey; needles rattle what wits it has left.
